events.title: Bright Nights by ANZ
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Bright Nights by ANZ transforms the Brisbane River into a dazzling, choreographed canvas of water, light, and sound. Floating fountains, waterscreens, amazing animated water features and water jets shooting up to 80 meters high, all pierced by a stunning laser light show, this bold installation fills the Festival Village precinct with colour, energy and emotion.

events.title: The Choir of Man
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Olivier Award-nominated, West End acclaimed, and globally adored, hundreds of thousands of fans across four continents can't be wrong. This is the show the whole world has been raising a glass to. Stunning harmonies and foot-stomping singalongs, brimming with hits, all with a real bar on stage. A wildly talented cast of nine (extra)ordinary guys, world-class tap dancers, slam poets, multi-instrumentalists and powerhouse singers, serve it all live.

This off-beat encounter will tickle your ribs and wobble your funny bone!

events.title: Pasifika Made
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Pasifika Made returns to Brisbane Festival in 2026, bringing together Pacific and First Nations artists, cultural practitioners and community across a program of cultural and contemporary live performance, workshops, artist talks, knowledge sharing, live demonstrations and a cultural marketplace experience. Transforming Festival Village into a gathering place for art, culture and connection, Pasifika Made presents Pacific arts through both ancestral practice and a contemporary lens.

events.title: RocKwiz Rocks Brisbane
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Get ready Brissy, RocKwiz are coming back to celebrate. Proudly part of the 2026 Brisbane Festival, RocKwiz presents a tailor made Brisbane show. From Cloudland and Festival Hall to the Fortitude Music Hall, from the Bee Gees to the 'Finger, The Saints to Savage Garden, The Grates to The Veronicas. RocKwiz will celebrate them all. Julia Zemiro, Brian Nankervis, the RocKwiz Orkestra, special guests, and punter contestants from the crowd will spin through trivia rounds, smash breakout musical interludes all in a live mixtape of fun and friendly competition. From the depths of "Pig City" to that "Striped Sunlight Sound" of Robert Forster and The Go-Betweens … RocKwiz Rocks Brisbane!

events.title: Piano Man: Celebrating the Music of Billy Joel
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: For more than 50 years, American singer, songwriter and pianist Billy Joel has made an indelible mark on the American songbook. With 33 top 40 hits, 5 Grammy Awards and over 160 million albums worldwide, he is one of the most successful artists of all time. This September at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, QSO under the baton of Jessica Gethin will celebrate Billy Joel in Piano Man. Directed by Mark Sutcliffe and starring Phil Burton, Alinta Chidzey, Jess Hitchcock and Josh Piterman, Piano Man features new orchestral arrangements by Nicholas Buc covering his greatest hits including Just the Way You Are, She's Always a Woman, New York State of Mind, Only the Good Die Young, Vienna and of course Piano Man. Featuring: Mark Sutcliffe director Nicholas Buc arranger Phil Burton vocalist Alinta Chidzey vocalist Jess Hitchcock vocalist Josh Piterman vocalist *Please note: This concert does not feature Billy Joel in person. Piano Man is presented in association with Make My Mark.
